group_results.task: First craft oak planks from your oak logs, then use the nearby crafting table to craft oak stairs from those planks.
First, mine some birch logs nearby. Use the crafting table in your inventory to craft a wooden pickaxe from the birch wood. Then find and mine the red nether bricks.
Mine the poppy flower, then use the nearby birch logs and crafting table to craft a birch button.

You have 4 oak logs in your inventory and there is a crafting table nearby on a stone platform. First, craft oak logs into oak planks. Then, use the crafting table to craft an oak door from the oak planks.
Craft an iron shovel using the crafting table, then use it to: mine the yellow concrete powder blocks, mine the red sand blocks, and dig snow layers to collect snowballs and craft a snow block.
